{
  "name": "@awebai/oats",
  "version": "0.55.1",
  "description": "OATS (Open Agent Team Specification) — durable souls, disposable instances, targetable capability packages, and the runtime-neutral oats CLI/kernel.",
  "keywords": [
    "agents",
    "oats",
    "cli"
  ],
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/awebai/oats"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "test": "node scripts/run-tests.mjs",
    "test:session": "node scripts/test-session-inheritance.mjs",
    "check": "node scripts/check-package-dry-runs.mjs --syntax-only",
    "check:pi": "node --experimental-strip-types --check packages/pi/extension/index.ts",
    "validate": "node scripts/validate-project.mjs",
    "pack:check": "node scripts/check-package-dry-runs.mjs",
    "smoke:tarball": "node scripts/clean-room-smoke.mjs"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./lib/core.mjs",
    "./core": "./lib/core.mjs",
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "bin/",
    "lib/",
    "skills/",
    "injects/",
    "docs/",
    "README.md",
    "package-catalog.json",
    "packages/record/bin/",
    "packages/record/lib/",
    "packages/record/docs/",
    "packages/record/test/vectors/",
    "packages/record/README.md",
    "packages/record/package.json",
    "packages/client/",
    "packages/tui/bin/",
    "packages/tui/lib/",
    "packages/tui/README.md",
    "packages/tui/package.json"
  ],
  "dependencies": {
    "@awebai/pi": "^0.2.1",
    "croner": "10.0.1",
    "yaml": "2.9.1"
  },
  "bin": {
    "oats": "./bin/oats.mjs"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "ajv": "8.17.1"
  }
}

{
  "name": "@awebai/oats-desktop",
  "version": "0.55.1",
  "private": true,
  "description": "OATS desktop app — Electron shell, integrated tmux terminal, and view host for the agent control panel.",
  "type": "module",
  "main": "main.mjs",
  "scripts": {
    "start": "electron .",
    "test": "node --test test/*.test.mjs",
    "rebuild": "electron-rebuild -f -w node-pty",
    "postinstall": "node build-vendor.mjs",
    "dist": "electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs",
    "postdist": "node scripts/clean-dist.mjs",
    "dist:smoke": "node scripts/dist-smoke.mjs",
    "icons": "node build-icons.mjs",
    "icons:lucide": "node build-lucide-icons.mjs"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@xterm/addon-fit": "^0.10.0",
    "@xterm/addon-webgl": "^0.18.0",
    "@xterm/xterm": "^5.5.0",
    "dompurify": "^3.4.12",
    "highlight.js": "^11.11.1",
    "marked": "^16.4.2",
    "node-pty": "^1.0.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@electron/rebuild": "^4.2.0",
    "electron": "^43.2.0",
    "electron-builder": "^26.8.1",
    "esbuild": "^0.28.1",
    "jsdom": "^29.1.1",
    "lucide": "1.48.0"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/awebai/oats"
}
